headline: Toyota Hikes Full-Year Profit Forecasts on Strong Hybrid Demand and Weak Yen
summary: Toyota raised its full-year profit forecasts, benefiting from robust global demand for hybrid electric vehicles and a weak Japanese yen.
why: As the world's largest automaker, Toyota's earnings outlook offers key insights into currency impact on manufacturing exports and consumer powertrain preferences.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: Upgraded profit forecasts driven by hybrid vehicle demand and favorable currency rates directly support equity value.
